policy.scope: ABR municipalities and designated-city wards cross-referenced to Japan Post; unlinked source rows retained separately
notes: Names do not determine identity: variants are checked only after a valid official-code join.
ABR city and ward columns explicitly identify the hierarchy; a ward's city component must resolve uniquely within the same prefecture.
County names remain address components, not fabricated municipal governments.
ABR effective dates are preserved as source values, not independently certified foundation dates.
Source rows without postal-code identity matches or matched ward descendants remain in the unresolved source report; no territorial boundary or claim is changed.
